main_body: pink blossom tree canopy on a vertical brown trunk with green ground patch
top_band: upper pink canopy clusters (rows 1-14) sitting above the front-facing lower cluster and trunk, with an elliptical grass base at rows 38-43
evidence: The tree has a volumetric 3/4 canopy of overlapping spherical clumps and a vertical trunk planted on an elliptical foreshortened ground shadow/grass patch (rows 38-43).

style.evidence: While the canopy has 5 pink steps and a dark maroon outline, the shading is inverted (dark at the top/back of each sphere, bright pale pink at the bottom edge) and arranged as four smooth round balls rather than leaf clusters. The trunk is a rigid 5px-wide vertical rectangle with a repetitive 1px checker pattern and a flat geometric green oval base, lacking the organic root flare, branch structure, and leaf-clump texture of the Beodeul reference trees.
